AI Usage Sentinel 1.8.1 migrates to the clearer repository name **ai-agent-usage-limit-reset-forecast**.

- Updated website, download, setup and update-channel URLs.
- The existing Ed25519 signing key, exact asset URL validation, checksum verification, app identifier and local data locations remain unchanged.
- A static compatibility site at the former Pages URL provides a signed migration update to 1.8.1 for older apps. After installing 1.8.1, update checks use the new website.
- Reset calendars retain filled date cells and each message retains its own confidence bar.

macOS 14+, universal Apple Silicon/Intel. Ad-hoc signed, not notarized. Windows/Linux remain unsigned beta ports with CI build and smoke-test coverage. Replace the existing app rather than running duplicate copies. No paid service is required for the rename or compatibility site.
